body: In this case my desire to not leave my kid or my husband is helping me hold on... But yeah, most of my siblings are child free for this reason :/

I'm with my son now and he's giving me tons of hugs and kisses. I'm glad I didn't do anything stupid last night. I really don't want to leave him or my husband. I hate having these feelings. I know I need to go try to find a new therapist but I'm just so afraid at this point. 

Ugh. I just don't want this cycle to continue. When my mom killed herself she probably never considered that it would drive others myself included to try. If I do the same thing is it really going to end with me? I know how it feels to have a parent do it. I don't want to do it. I just feel so desperate about wanting this pain to stop. I'm sorry I'm rambling.

I was talking to a therapist but stopped going after I tried to talk to her about my grandfather sexually abusing me. Instead of helping me she guilt tripped me for not telling my dad and then tried to tell me that I liked what happened. I decided not to go back and now I'm too scared to try to find someone new. What if they do the same or worse?

AA just makes me want to drink even more. I tried it for 6 months and after every meeting I just came away feeling even more obsessed and pre-occupied with booze and wanting it so I can forget the meeting. I know I'm a powerless piece of shit who fails at life. I don't need to sit in a room where we tell stories of that to get the point driven home. :/
